name: Sentry for Startups Credits
free_limit: Up to $5,000 in one-time Sentry product credits, valid for 12 months, plus priority support for startups accepted into the Sentry for Startups program.
watch_out: Eligibility requires startup founded in the past two years, under $5 million in venture funding, and new to paying for Sentry. Application approval is not automatic; separate YC/a16z partner deals cannot stack. Monitor bills and plan limits when credit expires or runs out. Card and commercial-use requirements for the program are not explicitly confirmed.
